# Inter

The panel UI's font (`core/ui/font.cpp`), compiled into the binary by
`cmake/embed_file.cmake` and rasterised at run time with stb_truetype, so the
console title needs no font file and no system font.

- File vendored: `Inter-Medium.ttf`, unmodified, from the release archive's
  `extras/ttf/` folder.
- Authors: The Inter Project Authors (Rasmus Andersson and contributors).
- Upstream: <https://github.com/rsms/inter>
- Version: 4.1 (`Inter-4.1.zip` from the GitHub release, retrieved 2026-10-27).
- SHA-256: `97ad806f526e41546d46365bb3a393145f75b7b1568913db74549ad8b8dba872`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, no Reserved Font Name (`OFL.txt`).
